All Autographs / One-of-One / Color-Matched Foil Boards

Every card in 2026 Alumination Just The Hits Football is numbered one-of-one across an extensive ladder of foil boards and color parallels. Signed and unsigned versions of each subset are produced, along with Mammoth oversized editions, Comix Covers, and multi-signature Comix Dual autographs.

Subsets &amp; Numbering

Each subset is shown with its Autograph and Base versions where both exist — toggle between them to see the card code, sample art, and foil boards. Nearly every card is numbered one-of-one; Rising Son unsigned base parallels follow the printed foil ladder. Autograph codes append a trailing A after the player initials (shown as ‹INI›).
